selection_constraints.statement: The selected package must serve only CONTROLLED_L03_DIRECT_QUESTION and must not silently define general interrogative grammar.
Any explicitly selected L01/L02 form, including KE, would become at most a newly proposed scoped L03 candidate and not inherited canon or productive grammar.
AN and EN are not part of this interrogative selection lane; subject/person remains separately unresolved.
Question-to-declarative derivation by removing KE, reordering, analogy or automatic inheritance remains prohibited.
Reference languages and numerology cannot select the surface package; I usually remains null and SARU remains distinct from usually.
If any required field remains unset, preserve NO_SELECTION_NO_CANDIDATE_PRESERVE_GAP and do not advance to candidate materialization.
